summary: Editas Medicine filed an 8-K under Items 7.01 and 8.01 to disclose a press release and preclinical data presentation for EDIT-401, its in vivo gene-editing candidate. The data show robust reductions in LDL-C, Lp(a), and ApoB in non-human primates. No transaction, corporate action, or special situation is announced; the filing is a routine disclosure of scientific results.
